role: New design-fixed synthetic mechanism experiment; independent of all historical SIR endpoints and results. Local pre-run freeze, not third-party preregistration.

model.reference_target: Exact conditional transition law of the stated L-substep explicit Euler implementation, not the continuous-time transition law
model.mean: Same exact Euler zero-noise transition mean for both coordinates; all alternatives retain the drift
model.support_boundary: sigma2=0 is a theoretical support example only, excluded from the main power grid

coordinates.finite_step: Sigma_step is the closed-form L-substep Euler covariance, equal to the tangent covariance in this linear family
coordinates.score: T=(1/(2*K))*sum_k r_k^T Sigma^{-1} r_k; full two-dimensional upper-tail energy; no pilot, fitted covariance, regularization, or score adaptation
coordinates.inversion: Float64 analytic 2x2 Cholesky; fail rather than regularize if non-positive or non-finite

monte_carlo.pairing: Within each geometry cell, both coordinates use exactly the same reference and held-out draws. Alternatives share held-out standard-normal scatter draws. Every outer replicate has its own independent reference bank.
monte_carlo.sampling: Bartlett Wishart(2,K,I) scatter matrices are exact sufficient draws for the K independent Gaussian Euler residuals; no microstep-path or time discretization approximation is introduced
monte_carlo.seed_rule: NumPy PCG64 with SeedSequence([master_seed,geometry_index,stream]); stream 0 for reference scatters, stream 1 for independent held-out scatters; ISO order not applicable

analysis.primary_estimand: D=P(p_finite_step<=alpha)-P(p_instantaneous<=alpha), separately for every non-null geometry/alternative cell
analysis.paired_difference_interval: Difference bounds from Clopper-Pearson intervals for p10 and p01, Bonferroni over the four tails; pointwise 95% and familywise 95% over all 96 predeclared non-null cells
analysis.null_calibration_intervals: Familywise 95% Clopper-Pearson intervals over the 32 coordinate-by-geometry null rates; target floor(alpha*(M+1))/(M+1)=0.05
analysis.classification: Equivalent only if simultaneous D interval is contained in [-0.02,0.02]; materially higher/lower only if the entire interval is above +0.02/below -0.02; otherwise unresolved. Numerical stability is a separate flag.
analysis.negative_controls: kappa=0 or L=1 implies identical covariance maps, scores and ranks, checked pathwise within floating-point tolerance
analysis.reporting: Report every predeclared cell, including nulls, equivalence, lower power, unresolved comparisons and numerical failures. Do not pool distinct strengths into a primary effect. No optional stopping or grid changes after run freeze.
analysis.limitations: Known linear implementation, constant covariance, upper-tail full-vector energy, no fitting uncertainty. Not a power analysis of SIR S_CE, not a general superiority claim for tangent coordinates. Matrix reweighting, unlike scalar rescaling of homogeneous energy, can change ranks.
